name: folder-motion
title: Folder (Motion)
author: AlgorizeTech
description: A tactile folder — skeleton cards or your own photos tuck behind a frosted-glass pocket and fan out into an arc on hover. Use it for file groups, galleries and drag-and-drop upload targets.
docs: Motion build of `folder` — same props, markup and install path; install one or the other. Named exports: Folder, SkeletonCard (plus FolderFile / FolderProps types). `files` is { thumb?, name?, progress? }[]; without files, `peek` skeleton cards show. `color` tints body, pocket, icon and cards via OKLCH; `icon` is a lucide component. Hover, tap or focus opens the fan; past five files it pages with arrows or by dragging a card. `interactive` adds drag-and-drop + click-to-browse with `onFiles`, `progress` and `onRemoveFile`. Pulls in `tooltip` for file-name hovers.
